title: Naming ceremony cake near Glenwood or Parklea? 100% eggless, Riverstone
summary:
A naming ceremony cake for Glenwood or Parklea families, 100% eggless, picked up at Riverstone Shopping Centre.

The guest list for a namkaran is set by the family, not the baby, which is why it tends to grow. Tell us the number and we match the size: a 6-inch serves 6-8 from $39.99, an 8-inch serves 12-14 from $49.99, a 10-inch serves 20-22 from $74.99.

No eggs in the sponge, the cream or any of the 15 flavours, so nobody at the ceremony has to ask. Send a photo of the design you have in mind, or the baby's new name for the top.

Order two days ahead. Pickup only, with free parking at the centre, a short drive from Glenwood, Parklea and Schofields. 🎂
